name: Recursive Double Bind

topology.recursion: repair or exit attempt is reframed as new evidence inside the original bind

activation: a repair or exit attempt is fed back into the same rule system
maintenance: the system consumes its own attempted correction
failed repair increases apparent validity of the original frame
signatures: naming the bind becomes proof of violation
leaving becomes evidence of guilt or disloyalty
falsePositives: ordinary disagreement about a proposed repair
a repair attempt that is rejected but does not reinforce the original bind

breakpoints.operation: prevent repair attempts from being reclassified under the original rule
move repair to a context not governed by the original frame
